Objectives

Specify an objective function for symplectic optimization

Compile a C++ objective for thread-safe evaluation

Solvers

Optimize an objective with a symplectic or accelerated-gradient method
sym_control()
Control parameters for symplectic optimizers
sym_sweep()
Sweep solver parameters over a grid
